systems.name: Learniq
systems.note: Rated by reading this repository at the branch head. Every rating carries a file path in built.evidence. The README and the app-store description were not used as evidence.

systems.name: Moodle LMS
systems.note: The free GPL-3.0 core, self-hostable. Drivable end to end through moodle.org/demo and docs.moodle.org, but nobody drove it in this pass. Rated no only where the vendor documents a capability as Workplace-only.

systems.name: Moodle Workplace
systems.note: The paid distribution, sold only through certified partners. No free tier and no public sandbox, so documentation is the ceiling of what anyone can check without buying it.

systems.name: ILIAS
systems.note: GPL, free self-host, strong European public-sector footing. A public demo at demo.ilias.de carries teacher, learner and supervisor accounts, so it is drivable. Nobody drove it in this pass.

systems.name: Totara
systems.note: A GPLv3 Moodle fork built for corporate and government compliance. Code access needs a subscription and there is no public demo, so documentation is the ceiling. This is the column where the evidence is thinnest relative to the threat.

systems.name: Chamilo
systems.note: GPLv3+, the lightest of the open LMSs to self-host, with a free public campus at campus.chamilo.org. Its published standards list is close to ours, which is why it is here. Nobody drove it in this pass.

systems.name: iSpring Learn
systems.note: Proprietary per-seat SaaS, no self-host, non-EU vendor. Included because its marketing targets our exact wedge: certificate expiry and renewal notifications. A 30-day trial makes it partly drivable.

pending.name: Give an ILIAS certificate an expiry and a recertification cycle.
pending.note: ILIAS badges demonstrably carry a validity date. Whether certificates do could not be settled from the public docs, and it decides several rows.

pending.name: Play SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI and QTI content in Totara.
pending.note: Totara is a Moodle fork so it likely inherits much of this, but likely is not a rating. No public demo, so it needs a partner conversation or a subscription.

pending.name: Issue badges to Open Badges 3.0 rather than 2.x.
pending.note: Moodle and ILIAS both ship Open Badges. Which version could not be settled from the pages read, and 3.0 is the claim that matters for wallets.

pending.name: Compare against the Dutch school systems schools actually run today.
pending.note: Magister, SOMtoday and ParnasSys are the real competitors for the pupil-tracking half. None is drivable without a school contract, so adding them now would fill the matrix with unknown. The Edu-V afsprakenstelsel publishes koppelvlak specs openly and is the one route to real cells.

pending.name: Keep a GDPR record of processing that updates itself from the data model.
